export const rawHtml = "<section id=\"module-auth_server.passwordless_client\">\n<span id=\"passwordless-client\"></span>\n<p>Passwordless Client for auth0-server-python SDK.</p>\n<p>Implements embedded passwordless login for a client:</p>\n<ul class=\"simple\">\n<li><p>Email OTP / SMS OTP - <code class=\"docutils literal notranslate\"><span class=\"pre\">start()</span></code> sends a code, <code class=\"docutils literal notranslate\"><span class=\"pre\">verify()</span></code> exchanges it for\ntokens via the passwordless-OTP grant and establishes a server-side session.</p></li>\n<li><p>Magic link - <code class=\"docutils literal notranslate\"><span class=\"pre\">start(send=&quot;link&quot;)</span></code> emails a one-click link. Completion is\nhandled by the standard callback (<code class=\"docutils literal notranslate\"><span class=\"pre\">ServerClient.complete_interactive_login</span></code>),\nnot by <code class=\"docutils literal notranslate\"><span class=\"pre\">verify()</span></code>.</p></li>\n</ul>\n<p>Tokens never leave the server. The browser holds only the opaque session.</p>\n<section id=\"attributes\">\n<h2>Attributes</h2>\n<table class=\"autosummary longtable docutils align-default\">\n<tbody>\n<tr
